description: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for different configurations of SepLLM in the post-training setting. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 95,000 to 125,000, and is labeled as "#Iteration." The y-axis represents the loss, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, and is labeled as "Loss." The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) in pink, SepLLM (n=128) in blue, SepLLM (n=64) in orange, and Vanilla before post-training in red dashed line. The pink line starts at approximately 2.9 loss at 95,000 iterations and decreases to around 2.2 loss at 125,000 iterations. The blue line starts at approximately 2.8 loss at 95,000 iterations and decreases to around 2.2 loss at 125,000 iterations. The orange line starts at approximately 2.9 loss at 95,000 iterations and decreases to around 2.2 loss at 125,000 iterations. The red dashed line remains constant at approximately 2.2 loss throughout the iterations.
